design: Secondary high-dimensional generalization study designed before scoring any of these three tasks. The cohort is the three NIPS 2003 challenge tasks absent from the development grid.
partition: Use the published training set for all fitting, screening and decisions. Split it 70:30 by stratified seed for fitting and ranking. Refit on the complete published train set after supports freeze. Open the public challenge validation labels only after all methods and seeds for the task have frozen. The unreleased competition test labels are not used.
predictor: L2 logistic regression, liblinear dual, C=1, tol=1e-5, max_iter=2000, seed of split; one thread. MaxAbs scaling fitted on training rows. On sparse count/binary inputs zero is a meaningful absence, and on dense Arcene the scalar used for each absent input is its training median. The sparse inputs also use coordinatewise training medians.
candidate_universe: Rank features by the univariate F statistic on inner fitting data with stable input-position tie breaks. Retain the first 256 finite-variable columns, shared across all screened methods. Record screened-full and unrestricted full logistic controls. Reorder the screen by absolute coefficient of the fitted 256-column model. The anchor is the first passing masked prefix against full-screened ranking AUC and accuracy (8% relative tolerance).
rules: Use existing frozen block/singleton search and 4 fixed weighting panels. Nested uses empty/next anchor-width/all. Separating uses distinct empty/full and middle-level constant-weight feature signatures. Random matched uses the same list of mask sizes, independently sampling distinct masks uniformly within size, seed separate from training and row panels. Point uses only the original panel. All masks share the initial anchor reference and relative 3% AUC/accuracy tolerances. Conditional prefix receives the separating arm width. L1 C in [0.01,0.1,1,10] selects maximum inner-ranking AUC after common L2 refit, then fewer columns; discard zero-width candidates, fallback to the first ranked column if all empty.
primary: Balanced error rate (BER) on the official challenge validation sample, following the original challenge. Secondary AUC, accuracy, retained width, selector cost and fitting time. Present every task, average over the five inner splits per task. A held-out recording is reused across seeds. No pooled hypothesis test across three tasks or five seeds. All cohorts, failures and fallbacks reported.
timing: CPU in-process diagnostic accounting. Record own selection time, actual final refit plus prediction time, and common screening/anchor components separately. Never describe these as process-cold head-to-head times. One hour maximum per dataset/seed.
official_data: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/{uci_id}/{name}.zip (UCI Machine Learning Repository). Preserve per-archive and member hashes, results, predictions, support names and partition indices. Do not redistribute raw files via manuscript source ZIP.
